title: High-flux sub-Poissonian twin fields generation from warm atomic vapor
summary: We demonstrate the generation of sub-Poissonian twin fields via near-degenerate spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM) in warm $^{85}\mathrm{Rb}$ vapor at 795~nm. When seeded with a weak coherent field, the generated twin beams exhibit approximately $5.5~\mathrm{dB}$ of intensity-difference squeezing in free space and retain about $3~\mathrm{dB}$ after coupling into polarization-maintaining (PM) fibers.
